Translate feature names to the ariadne nomenclature

Source: R/translate.R
translate.Rd

edge2node .featureDictionary

Usage

.featureDictionary

edge2node(edges)

Arguments

edges

Character list. A named list of resource versions to load. Latest versions are used if not specified. (Default: NULL)

Value

An igraph object with the ariadne resource graph.

Examples

# Prepare example edges table
edge_df <- data.frame(
    from = c("ncbi", "GO"),
    to = c("BugSigDB", "FooDB")
)

# Derive nodes table from edges table
node_df <- edge2node(edge_df)

# View nodes table
node_df
#>     name specific
#> 1  taxid     ncbi
#> 2     go       GO
#> 3 bugsig BugSigDB
#> 4  foodb    FooDB
